verdict.rationale: AWS's own docs index lists a first-party service to "Run code without thinking about servers" (aws-docs-39). Lambda functions are also referenced as callable targets (aws-docs-35), and Amplify tutorials describe building serverless web apps (aws-docs-31). The pack confirms the serverless offering exists but gives only glancing mentions. missing for 10: documented trigger/event-source types, documented limits (timeouts, memory, concurrency), cold-start behavior documentation, serverless container option, independent or hands-on corroboration.
